name: status:backlog
description: Not ready yet: the definition of ready is not met

name: status:ready
description: Meets the definition of ready and can be picked up

name: status:in-review
description: Pull request open, waiting for review or checks

name: status:blocked
description: Waiting on a named dependency or decision

name: type:task
description: One slice of work with acceptance criteria

name: type:checkpoint
description: Go or no-go review of the slices it covers

name: type:bug
description: Something does not work as specified

name: type:rfc
description: Systemic proposal under discussion in docs/rfc/

name: type:post-mortem-action
description: One concrete change from a post-mortem

name: incident
description: A production incident, SEV-1 to SEV-4; open to close is time to restore

name: human-approved
description: A person approved this protected-path change. Never set by an agent; the merge guard enforces it.
